guide: This is a plain account of a day with no building done, plus how to keep a project moving on days like that. You need an app project, Claude Code or Codex, and an Android phone.
1. Open your app project in Claude Code and ask it to build an Android debug APK, which is an installable test copy of the app.
1. Copy the APK to your Android phone with Google Drive or a USB cable, then open it to install it.
1. Turn on "Install unknown apps" for the app you opened the file from, if Android blocks the install.
1. Use the app on the phone before you change any code, and write down what looks wrong or feels slow.
1. Before a busy day, ask Claude Code to make a small change, check it runs, and write a short note of what changed and what to do next.
1. Keep that note in Notion or in a file in the project, so the next session starts from it.
1. If you miss a day, say so in your log and pick up from the note without trying to catch up.
Watch out: install only an APK you built yourself, and don't spend a free evening on a big change you can't test on the phone.
